title: Form / structured input
description: A data-capture form: sections grouping fields, each field a typed attribute, with validation rules and the form itself a governed information artifact.

mapping.notes: a field becomes an attribute with a type; required markers set required=true; identity fields set identity=true
a validation constraint becomes a rule applying to the entity
the form/section becomes an information record with sourceDocument provenance

guidance: Each field becomes an attribute; capture its type, requiredness, and any allowed values.
Validation notes and constraints become rules, not free text.
Record the form as an information artifact so its origin and freshness are governed.
